adapter_default_deny: every adapter_invoke must resolve through the shared genuine resolution to a landed bridge entry; unregistered, tampered, versioned-wrong, or effectful rows refuse with VM_LOWER_OPCODE_UNSUPPORTED at lowering judgment, execution, surcharge, and gate admission alike

boundaries.final_ga: complete eventual Machine Genesis/WITNESS release surface; a strict superset owned by later packages (RW-160); this profile implies nothing about it
boundaries.rw070_abi_image_freeze: later artifact/import/runtime boundary qualification; this profile binds current import identities and schemas for closure evidence only and freezes no external host ABI
boundaries.this_profile: exact semantic/execution subset sufficient to build the Sley toolchain (REWEAVE 10.2 closure)

budgets.rule: every closure vector completes successfully within the reference budgets; a resource-limit termination under these budgets is a profile violation, not a passing vector

call_rules.inventory_coverage: every inventory function must be reached from the entry (no unjudged dead code rides an admission; callers narrow inventories first, as lowering does)
call_rules.rationale: multi-function structure is required (10.2 items 2, 4, 5); recursion is not independently necessary (every bounded recursion rewrites iteratively; deeper-than-256 structures require iteration); the 256-frame ceiling stays as VM-enforced defense in depth

ceilings.note: code-pinned values; the S20-210 constant ceiling (1,000,000 elements) binds direct vector inputs below the bridge cap (2^20): V2B1-at-cap and PSH1-at-max are reachable only through single-execution chains, and V2B1-over-cap is unreachable by construction (recorded, defense in depth)

excluded_opcodes.144_contract_assert: not required; CondBranch+Trap substitutes for internal assertions and Result+branch for error accumulation; keeps E7 uniformly out
excluded_opcodes.145_160_162_e7: full MG obligation (G-2/RW-160); test execution, effect requests, capability narrowing
excluded_opcodes.193_global_get: not required; constant_ref covers embedded constants
excluded_opcodes.194_function_ref: not required; direct calls cover known-callee dispatch; no dynamic dispatch in the closure
excluded_opcodes.80_to_85_floats: not required; the closure is integer/byte/map-indexed; exclusion keeps host float-environment dependence out of the bootstrap determinism claim

gate.admission_report: functions in pre-order (entry first), operation count, bridge-use count; only reached functions are judged
gate.refusal_vocabulary: LowerErrorCode (shared with lowering; no new codes)
gate.single_authority_rule: membership only (opcode set, type forms, acyclicity, empty effects/contracts/type-parameters, import registry); reference integrity, operand agreement, CFG validity, canonical forms, and resource accounting stay with S20-210/S20-220/lowering/execution
gate.static_admission: not an execution path; EXTENDED_V1 lowering/execution unchanged; no execution entry calls the gate

iteration.canonical: cfg-backedge-loop-form-A with block-parameter or cell state (RW-040 loop-form mapping; cond-drain-loop cell evidence retained)
iteration.recursion: excluded from the subset; recursive call cycles refuse with VM_LOWER_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED

permitted_imports.rows_note: each entry is a genuine epoch-1 AdapterImport (identity SLY1/BRIDGE/<code> zero-padded to 32 bytes, adapter identity equal, abi_version 1, empty effect list); push instantiates by monomorphization (landed: UInt(8) representative, Unit trail); unknown identities remain denied and do not imply an extensible registry

permitted_opcodes_note: E1 data + base booleans, E2 checked integers, E4 records/variants/maps, E5 cells + value_hash, E6 direct calls; opcode 161 admitted only through genuine bridge resolution, never by tag

types.cells: execution-local only (LocalCell in operation results and block parameters for in-execution state threading; never in function parameters, function results, or constants)

unsupported_fail_closed: any opcode, terminator use, type form, import, effect, contract, or type parameter outside this record refuses before execution with the shared lowering vocabulary; fallback to a broader runtime profile never occurs silently
